abilities.name: Molten Core
abilities.description: Channel on an allied or destroyed Fort or Keep to replace it with Ragnaros's ultimate form, temporarily gaining new Abilities, having 3996 Health that burns away over 18 seconds. Ragnaros returns to his normal form upon losing all Health in Molten Core.

fields.notes: Interrupting Molten Core during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Ragnaros can exit Molten Core after a 1 second channel by reactivating the Trait. Exiting can be canceled by pressing the Trait button again before the channel is complete. Successfully casting Molten Core puts real Ragnaros and the target Structure in Stasis for its duration and replaces them with different Molten Core Ragnaros unit. In addition to usual effects of Stasis, real Ragnaros is removed from ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles), has no collision, cannot regenerate Health, Mana, Energy or Shields and cannot be seen on the minimap or revealed. Molten Core Ragnaros cannot be targeted by friendly Abilities during Molten Core. Buffs, like Heal over time effects, applied to real Ragnaros beforehand persist for their duration, but cannot affect Molten Core Ragnaros. Molten Core Ragnaros cannot be targeted or affected by Abathur's Ultimate Evolution, Sylvanas's Black Arrow disable or Zagara's Devouring Maw.

abilities.name: Empower Sulfuras
abilities.description: Ragnaros's next Basic Attack is instant, dealing 191 Spell Damage in an area, and heals for 20% of the damage dealt. Healing doubled versus Heroes. purpletext Molten Core: Molten Swing Stun and damage nearby enemies.

fields.notes: Cooldown starts when the Ability is triggered by attacking an enemy. Empower Sulfuras will miss completely and the Ability’s cooldown will be consumed if Ragnaros is Blinded or the primary target of the attack is Evading. Activating during the windup of a Basic Attack will cause that attack to be the empowered attack (splashing and dealing Spell Damage) and the reset to happen immediately afterward, the second being a normal Basic Attack (dealing Physical Damage and not splashing).

abilities.name: Molten Core - Molten Swing
abilities.description: Swing your hammer in a wide arc, dealing moderate (161) damage and Stunning enemies for 1 second. Damage increased by 25% versus Minions and Mercenaries.

fields.notes: Search area is split into three 60 degree sectors, rotating counter-clockwise over 0.375 seconds.

abilities.name: Living Meteor
abilities.description: Summon a meteor at the target point that deals 68 damage, then rolls in the target direction dealing 272 damage per second for 1.75 seconds. purpletext Molten Core: Meteor Shower Drop a line of meteor impacts.

fields.notes: Meteor can damage enemies multiple times as it rolls.

abilities.description: Summon 3 meteors at the target point that fall in the target direction. Each meteor deals moderate (151) damage and Slows enemies by 25% for 2 seconds. Damage increased by 25% versus Minions and Mercenaries.

abilities.name: Blast Wave
abilities.description: Ignite Ragnaros or an ally, granting 25% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds before exploding, dealing 104 damage to nearby enemies. purpletext Molten Core: Explosive Rune Cause a delayed explosion in a large area.

fields.props: Area of Effect (damage), Movement Speed buff

talents.name: Blistering Attacks
talents.description: Every 10 seconds, Ragnaros's next Basic Attack against a Hero deals 60% bonus damage. Hitting enemies with Basic Abilities reduces this cooldown by 1 second.

fields.notes: Every enemy hit including Structures triggers the cooldown reduction. Cannot empower damage on Basic Attacks affected by Empower Sulfuras. Damage from Blast Echo and Meteor Bomb talents can grant cooldown reduction, but periodic damage from Giant Scorcher doesn't. Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Ragnaros's Basic Attack damage.
